```sql
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN T1.price_to_income > T2.price_to_income THEN 'Lakeland'
        ELSE 'Rochester, NY'
    END AS warehouse,
    T1.price_to_income AS price_to_income
FROM 
    doorstep.ch1_national_series AS T1
JOIN 
    doorstep.ch8_metros AS T2
ON 
    T1.metros = T2.cbsa_code
WHERE 
    T1.year = 2008
ORDER BY 
    price_to_income DESC
LIMIT 1;
```

```sql
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN t1.price_to_income > t2.price_to_income THEN 'Charleston-North Charleston, SC'
        ELSE 'Fayetteville-Springdale-Rogers, AR'
    END AS location,
    t1.price_to_income AS price_to_income
FROM 
    doorstep.mart_metro_year AS t1
JOIN 
    doorstep.fct_metro_year AS t2
ON 
    t1.cbsa_code = t2.cbsa_code
WHERE 
    t1.year = 2018;
```

```sql
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN T1.on_time / T1.flown > T2.on_time / T2.flown THEN 'HA'
        ELSE 'WN'
    END AS result
FROM 
    turnaround.export_ch5_ranking AS T1
JOIN 
    turnaround.export_ch5_ranking AS T2
ON 
    T1.carrier = T2.carrier AND T1.year = T2.year AND T1.month = T2.month AND T1.flights = T2.flights AND T1.raw_rank = T2.raw_rank
WHERE 
    T1.year = 2016 AND T2.year = 2016
ORDER BY 
    T1.raw_rank DESC
LIMIT 1;
```


```sql
SELECT 
    CASE
```


```sql
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN T1.on_time > T2.on_time THEN 'Hawaiian'
        ELSE 'Republic'
    END AS carrier,
    T1.on_time AS on_time_hawaiian,
    T2.on_time AS on_time_republic,
    T1.on_time * 100 / T1.flown AS on_time_hawaiian_percent,
    T2.on_time * 100 / T2.flown AS on_time_republic_percent
FROM 
    turnaround.mart_carrier_month AS T1
JOIN 
    turnaround.mart_carrier_month AS T2 ON T1.carrier = T2.carrier AND T1.year = T2.year AND T1.month = T2.month
WHERE 
    T1.year = 2019 AND T2.year = 2019 AND T1.carrier = 'HA' AND T2.carrier = 'YX';
```

```sql
SELECT
```

```sql
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN payment_share ASH > payment_share PROV THEN 'ASH'
        ELSE 'PROV'
    END AS warehouse,
    payment_share ASH AS payment_share_ashville,
    payment_share PROV AS payment_share_provo
FROM 
    doorstep.mart_metro_year ASH
WHERE 
    cbsa_title = 'Asheville, NC' AND year = 2015
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN payment_share ASH > payment_share PROV THEN 'ASH'
        ELSE 'PROV'
    END AS warehouse,
    payment_share ASH AS payment_share_ashville,
    payment_share PROV AS payment_share_provo
FROM 
    doorstep.mart_metro_year PROV
WHERE 
    cbsa_title = 'Provo-Orem-Lehi, UT' AND year = 2015
ORDER BY 
    payment_share_ashville DESC, payment_share_provo DESC;
```

```sql
SELECT CASE 
           WHEN median_income_sacramento_richardson > median_income_los_angeles THEN 'Sacramento-Roseville-Folsom, CA'
           ELSE 'Los Angeles'
         END AS median_income_higher
FROM (
  SELECT median_income_sacramento_richardson, median_income_los_angeles
  FROM doorstep.mart_metro_year
  WHERE cbsa_title = 'Sacramento-Roseville-Folsom, CA' AND year = 2007
  UNION ALL
  SELECT median_income_sacramento_richardson, median_income_los_angeles
  FROM doorstep.mart_metro_year
  WHERE cbsa_title = 'Los Angeles-Long Beach-Anaheim, CA' AND year = 2007
) AS subquery;
```
